summary: Comprehensive frontend UI testing of boxRadar Expo/React Native web preview. Tested welcome, auth (login aminata/lucas/kwame), discover tab with trip/parcel toggle and origin search filter, listing detail, make-offer modal + chat navigation, sending text messages, accept-offer as owner (lucas), delivery banner, validate screen, messages tab with status pills, profile screen, sign-out, register step navigation, and post tab form. All documented testIDs are present and interactive elements are tappable.

issues: Bottom sheet 'Make an offer' can place the submit-offer-btn below the viewport on 390x844 mobile when the keyboard is open; Playwright had to scroll the submit button into view. On a real device, KeyboardAvoidingView likely handles this, but the sheet could use an inner ScrollView or reduce top padding so the CTA remains visible with keyboard open.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated — use 'boxShadow'; 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated — use 'style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up (likely in styles with shadowColor/shadowOpacity shorthand and in ImageBackground/LinearGradient usage).

verified_flows: Welcome screen renders with radar pulse + Create account + Sign in CTAs (testIDs welcome-create-account-btn, welcome-signin-btn)
Login with aminata@boxradar.app / Demo123! lands on Discover (testID discover-screen)
Login with lucas@boxradar.app and kwame@boxradar.app both succeed
Discover tab shows 5 trip listings and 2 parcel listings from seed data (Paris, Lyon→Abidjan, London→Accra, Rome→Cairo, Nice→Bamako)
Tab toggle tab-trip / tab-parcel filters the list
Origin search (search-origin='Paris') narrows list to 1 listing
Tap listing-card-<id> → listing-detail-screen with hero image, route FROM/TO, date/weight/price meta, user card, make-offer CTA
make-offer-btn → opens sheet with offer-price-input + offer-message-input + submit-offer-btn; submit creates conversation and redirects to chat-screen
chat-screen shows offer bubble (€77) and supports sending text via chat-input + chat-send-btn (message appears in messages-list)
Owner (lucas) sees accept-offer-btn + reject-offer-btn on PENDING offer; tapping accept-offer-btn transitions the conversation to ACCEPTED and shows delivery-banner

delivery-banner tap → validate-screen with validation-code-input and submit-code-btn (traveler view 'Enter validation code on arrival' rendered correctly since lucas is trip owner == traveler for type=trip)
Messages tab (testID messages-screen, conversations-list) renders conversation-<id> rows with PENDING / ACCEPTED status pills
Profile tab renders profile-screen with profile-name and profile-signout-btn; sign-out clears session and returns to welcome-screen

Register flow: register-screen → register-type-{sender|traveler|pro} cards tappable → register-step-next-btn navigates to step 2 with register-name-input, register-email-input, register-phone-input, register-password-input, register-submit-btn; register-back-btn returns to step 1

Post tab renders create-screen with create-type-parcel/create-type-trip toggle, create-title, create-origin-city, create-origin-country, create-dest-city, create-dest-country, create-date, create-weight, create-price, create-desc, create-submit-btn (all testIDs confirmed present)
action_items: Minor: Replace deprecated 'shadow*' style props with 'boxShadow' across StyleSheets to silence console warnings.
Minor: In the listing detail offer modal, wrap the sheet content in a ScrollView or pin the submit-offer-btn above the keyboard so CTA is always visible on small viewports.
Optional: Add a small delay/animation on signout to ensure navigation to welcome is immediate (observed ~1-2s delay after state change).
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts correctly pulls EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env with no fallback — good.
auth.tsx stores token in AsyncStorage and hydrates via /auth/me on mount — good.
chat polls every 4s via setInterval — OK for MVP; consider websockets later for scale.
All TouchableOpacity/TextInput interactive elements tested have testID attributes — testability is excellent.
Alert.alert is used for errors inside modals (offer submit, chat send); fine on native but renders as window.alert on web — acceptable for MVP.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Test created 1 additional conversation between aminata and lucas on TEST_Lyon→Abidjan (offer €77, message 'Hello from test'). Offer was accepted → delivery in_transit state. Safe to retain or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend UI is in good shape. To avoid session-persistence flakiness across logins, either clear localStorage between tests or explicitly tap profile-signout-btn and wait 3-4 seconds for welcome-screen before the next login attempt. Expo Router deep-link URLs that work: /(tabs)/messages, /(tabs)/profile, /(tabs)/create. The conversation rows use testID pattern conversation-<uuid>. The validate screen is mounted at /validate/<delivery_id> with testIDs: validate-screen, validate-close, validation-code-input, submit-code-btn. Create form testIDs all prefixed create-*. Register flow is two-step with register-type-<role> and register-step-next-btn.
rca_of_issue: No critical bugs. The only functional friction is the make-offer modal submit button being pushed below the viewport when the soft keyboard is open on 390x844 (web emulation); KeyboardAvoidingView with behavior='padding' on iOS and undefined on Android should handle this on real devices, but the web preview shows it clipped. Mitigation: make the sheet scrollable or render the CTA as a sticky footer inside the sheet.
